newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Cifra up on Wal-Mart news.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Cifra up on Wal-Mart news.

text.p: Shares of Mexican retailer Cifra SA rose firmly Tuesday on demand from local and foreign buyers after news of a deal with joint venture partner Wal-Mart Stores Inc, traders said.
"This is a positive announcement...the share is going to give extraordinary yields," one dealer said.
Wal-Mart and Cifra agreed Tuesday to fold their Mexican joint venture into Cifra, and Wal-Mart will eventually take a 50 percent stake in Cifra with a $1.2 billion investment.
Traders said Cifra was one of the most active issues on the Mexican bourse, registering 10 percent of total volume in the first three hours of trading.
Cifra "A" shares stood at 13.80 pesos, against its Monday close at 13.50, but was off its high for the day of 14.30 at the open.
At one stage Cifra's "A" and "B" series CIFb.MX were both up more than four percent, but they later moved back. "C" series shares was less buoyant.
Traders said the price reversal probably came as the euphoria of the announcement died down and analysts started to pick over the details of the deal.
